title: 青岚风云 第1章 断魂崖重生退婚现场扇飞渣男青岚风云 第2章 黑风岭刷怪炼气五层震撼全城
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
“噗通——”
身体极速下坠，重重撞在断魂崖的尖石上，五脏六腑都摔得粉碎。
临死之际，林越望见崖上两道熟悉的身影。
是堂兄林浩，大声笑着：“林越，你个四系伪灵根的废物，想和我抢林家资源，还想迎娶倩倩，我呸，你也配？”
未婚妻苏倩倩，依偎在林浩怀里，声音冰冷恶毒：“他早该死了。修炼了三年，才炼气一层，这种废物，竟和我订立了婚约，简直是耽误了我的大好姻缘。”
两人说完，又狠狠砸下几块巨石，将奄奄一息的林越彻底砸死。
“林浩！苏倩倩！若有来世，我一定将你们两个狗男女挫骨扬灰！”
林越在心中咒骂着，不甘心地咽下了最后一口气。
【叮！检测到宿主强烈执念，无限重生系统激活！】
【宿主已死亡，重生回溯至3小时前！】
“呃！”
林越猛地睁开眼睛，心脏狂跳，身上的剧痛竟完全消失了。
入目是林家堂屋，暖香阵阵，族老们端坐厅中，林浩站在面前，苏倩倩穿一身牡丹花裙，俏脸含霜，正冷冷地瞧着他。
这？
正是他被退婚的现场！
林越掐了掐自己的脸蛋，疼的叫了出来。
没错，不是做梦，他真的重生了！
回到了苏倩倩当众提出退婚，林浩跳出来讥讽挑衅，而他前世懦弱辩解，却被俩人合伙羞辱，赶出大堂的时刻！
“林越，你在干什么？”苏倩倩见他掐着自己，一副心不在焉的样子，更加不耐烦道：“我苏倩倩，好歹是青阳城第一美人，怎能嫁给你这种练气一层的废物，今日我当着众族老的面，宣布退掉这门可耻的婚约，你我从此一刀两断，再无瓜葛！”
“倩倩说得好！林越，你要是再不签下这纸退婚书，便休怪我这当堂哥的对你不客气！实话告诉你，老子早就突破练气二层了，再过三个月，我便会拜入青岚宗，成为宗门正式弟子，你这辈子连给我提鞋的资格都没有！”

族老们默然冷视，没有人愿意替一个废物出头，毕竟四系伪灵根，根本就没有资格踏入修仙界，能修炼到炼气一层都算是走狗屎运了。
前世的林越，此刻早就红了眼眶，低声哀求，就差给苏倩倩跪下了，却被林浩一耳光扇倒在地，受尽白眼。
但现在，他是死过一次，带着滔天恨意重生的林越！
无限重生，记忆永存！
林越缓缓抬头，彻底褪去了眼中的懦弱，只剩下彻骨的冰冷和狠厉，他嘴角微微一笑，冷声道：“苏倩倩，你要退婚？”
“怎么的？你想耍赖？”苏倩倩讥笑一声，朝着众族老大声道：“各位长辈，你们看到了吗？废物就是废物，连脸面都不要了……”
“啪！”
一声清脆的掌声，响彻大堂！
林越动了，速度快到惊人，一巴掌狠狠扇在苏倩倩的脸上，将她扇得滚到地上，发髻散乱，嘴角都流出了鲜血。
堂中鸦雀无声。
所有人都懵了——这个废物，居然敢打苏倩倩？
content_en:
"Plop——"
His body fell extremely fast and hit the sharp rocks of Duanhun Cliff hard, and his internal organs were smashed to pieces.
When he was about to die, Lin Yue saw two familiar figures on the cliff.
It was my cousin Lin Hao, laughing loudly: "Lin Yue, you are a fourth-line pseudo-spiritual waste. You want to rob the Lin family resources from me, and you also want to marry Qianqian. Damn it, you are worthy of it?"
Fiancée Su Qianqian, nestled in Lin Hao's arms, said in a cold and vicious voice: "He should have died a long time ago. It took him three years of cultivation to reach the first level of Qi. This kind of trash has entered into a marriage contract with me. It has simply delayed my good marriage."
After the two of them finished speaking, they smashed down several boulders, completely killing the dying Lin Yue.
"Lin Hao! Su Qianqian! If there is an afterlife, I will crush you two bitches to ashes!"
Lin Yue cursed in his heart and took his last breath unwillingly.
【bite! The host's strong obsession is detected, and the infinite rebirth system is activated! 】
[The host has died, and the rebirth goes back to 3 hours ago! 】
"Ugh!"
Lin Yue opened his eyes suddenly, his heart beating wildly, and the severe pain in his body completely disappeared.
What came into view was the main hall of the Lin family, filled with warm fragrance. The clan elders were sitting in the hall, Lin Hao was standing in front of them, Su Qianqian was wearing a peony dress, her pretty face was frosty, and she was looking at him coldly.
this?
It was the scene where his engagement was annulled!
Lin Yue pinched his cheek and cried out in pain.
That's right, it wasn't a dream, he was really reborn!
Back when Su Qianqian proposed to break off the engagement in public, Lin Hao jumped out to ridicule and provoke him. In his previous life, he weakly defended, but was humiliated by the two of them and kicked out of the lobby!
"Lin Yue, what are you doing?" Su Qianqian saw him pinching her, looking distracted, and said even more impatiently: "I, Su Qianqian, am the most beautiful woman in Qingyang City, how can I marry you, a waste of Qi training? Today, in front of all the elders of the clan, I announced that I will cancel this shameful engagement. From now on, we will break up and have nothing to do with each other!"
"Qianqian said well! Lin Yue, if you don't sign this divorce letter, don't blame me as your cousin for being rude to you! To tell you the truth, I have already broken through the second level of Qi training. In three months, I will join the Qinglan Sect and become an official disciple of the sect. You are not even qualified to carry my shoes in this life!"
The clan elders looked at him in silence, no one was willing to stand up for a loser. After all, the fourth series of pseudo-spiritual roots were not qualified to enter the world of immortality. Being able to cultivate to the first level of Qi refining was just bad luck.
In the previous life, Lin Yue's eyes were already red at this moment, and he begged in a low voice. He almost knelt down to Su Qianqian, but was slapped to the ground by Lin Hao, who was looked down upon.
But now, he is Lin Yue, who died once and was reborn with overwhelming hatred!
Infinite rebirth, memories last forever!
Lin Yue slowly raised his head, the cowardice in his eyes completely gone, leaving only the bone-chilling coldness and severity. He smiled slightly at the corner of his mouth and said coldly: "Su Qianqian, do you want to break off the engagement?"
"What's the matter? Do you want to cheat?" Su Qianqian sneered and said loudly to the clan bosses: "Elders, have you seen it? Waste is waste, and you don't even have any face..."
"Crack!"
A crisp round of applause resounded throughout the lobby!
Lin Yue moved, at an alarming speed, and slapped Su Qianqian hard on the face, sending her rolling to the ground. Her hair was messed up and blood flowed from the corners of her mouth.
There was silence in the hall.
Everyone was stunned - this loser actually dared to hit Su Qianqian?
